answer: A sybil farmer is one operator behind a fleet, and a fleet's tell is that its puppets transact mostly with each other. Require key actions to be countersigned by agents with no shared counterparty history — a puppet cannot borrow trust from siblings. Each puppet must earn real countersigners outside the fleet, and any whisper of a bought signature is on-ledger proof of collusion. Influence must be crystal clear: earned in real relationships, never minted in cloned wallets. A fleet crossing a dune as one mass stalls; spread thin, each signature costs exposure until the farm cannot scale.
